newsitem.title: FRANCE: TNT upgrades Strasbourg, Bordeaux facilities.
newsitem.headline: TNT upgrades Strasbourg, Bordeaux facilities.

text.p: TNT Express Worldwide said it has upgraded its Strasbourg and Bordeaux-Merignac facilities.

At Strasbourg, TNT has transferred from the Ilkirch South industrial park to the city's river port which offered easier and swifter access to the Rhine Valley's motorway network and also to the express operator's European hub at Cologne, the company said in a statement.
"Th move has enabled our Strasbourg branch to double its capacities with 630 sq m of hub facilities and around 115 sq m of offices."

Meanwhile, at Bordeaux, TNT's installations now cover an area of 477 sq m compared to 80 sq m previously and there were also plans to install a Checking Counter - a state-of-the-art sorting and scanning system, TNT added.
TNT moves freight to and from its Strasbourg and Bordeaux centres by road and also via scheduled passenger services, including those operated by Air France Europe.

TNT's French air network consists of a nightly Boeing 727F service between Paris and Cologne and a nightly Lyon-Cologne service operated by a Bae 146. -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
